versions.changelog:
Initial release of Coding Buddy.

- Virtual coding companion that you must feed and care for between commits.
- Features 73+ species, pixel art portraits, real-time hunger, and permanent death.
- Your buddy evolves as you check in regularly.
- Provides REST API endpoints for registration, adoption, care actions, and status.
- Includes unique actions like feeding, playing, and medicine for pet care.
- See all creatures and community graveyard at animalhouse.ai.
